name: Castricum aan Zee
info: Steep dune, about 20m tall about 1 km North of the main entrance to the beach. Good lift in light winds, but difficult to climb for launch. It is easier to climb the less steep dunes closer to the entrance to the beach.
At the steeper dunes, the wind gradient can make it so there's very little wind down at the beach.
Can get crowded on weekends and holidays.
Strandhuisjes during Summer. Be prepared to walk quite some distance to reach dunes not blocked by them, avoid flying near them if possible.
Beware of thorny bushes at the top of the steeper dunes.

name: Rockanje Noord
info: Steep dune around 12m tall, good lift in light wind.
Occassionaly closed due to the bird breeding season March 15 to August 15. You can then fly at the southern beach. Always respect beach closures.
Very turbulent with strong winds due to the presence of land upwind.
Smaller site with very small liftband, which can make it difficult to fly if there's more than a couple pilots in the air. If possible, avoid on weekends and holidays.
The wind gradient due to the steep dunes can make it so there's very little wind down at the beach, but the lift once in the air is better than expected.

name: Rockanje Zuid

name: Ouddorp Noord
info: Flat dune, just 7m tall. Requires decent wind to fly.
Do not fly before 18:00 in the Summer if the beach is crowded. Occassionaly closed during Summer due to the bird breeding season. Always respect beach closures.
Very small site that can get very crowded. If possible, avoid on weekends and holidays.

name: Renesse
info: Flat dune about 10m tall, requires decent wind to fly.
Do not fly before 18:00 in the Summer if the beach is crowded. Stay away from Strandpaviljoen Corazon to avoid complaints.
Very small site that can get very crowded. If possible, avoid on weekends and holidays.
Watch out for the thorny bushes on the dune. There's also thorny trees behind the dune, avoid getting swept over the dune at all costs.
Few launch places made complicated by the prevalent thorny bushes. Good groundhandling advised.
Watch out for rotor and landing hazards due to the front dune.

name: Zoutelande
info: Moderately steep, tall dune, about 45m, good lift in light winds because of the large wind gradient. Takeoff only possible from the top.
Flying forbidden 10:00-18:00 in the period of June 15th to September 1st due to crowds at the beach. Pay attention to the rules on where you can land. Violations often result in fines.

Due to the steepness and height of the dune, there is an extreme wind gradient at Zoutelande. The wind will be much stronger than forecasted at the top of the dune, and there may be no wind at all at the beach. Only attempt to fly in strong winds if you are an experienced pilot and very confident in your groundhandling. In light winds, try to lose as little altitude as possible on launch, and stay close to the terrain.
No takeoff from the bottom. Small and crowded takeoff at the top, only really suitable for experienced pilots with good ground handling.
Large thorny trees behind the takeoff. Be careful and avoid getting swept behind the dune at all costs.
Watch out for rotor and landing hazards due to the front dune.
